name: dsu_full
justification: The chain merges the first i+2 vertices after operation i; later self/repeated unions keep [1,100000].

name: kruskal_full
justification: The graph is a chain with loops and more expensive parallel edges. Each cut needs its -1000000000 chain edge; total -99999000000000.

name: prim_full
justification: The graph is a chain with loops and more expensive parallel edges. Each cut needs its -1000000000 chain edge; total -99999000000000.

name: scc_full_chain
justification: Every non-loop edge moves forward, so every vertex is a separate SCC. Duplicate edges collapse to the chain condensation.

name: scc_full_cycle
justification: The first 100000 edges form one directed cycle through all vertices, so there is one SCC.

name: topo_full_cycle
justification: The all-vertex directed cycle has no topological order.

name: topo_full_chain
justification: The chain requires increasing vertex order; duplicate edges do not introduce cycles.

name: dag_full_chain
justification: Every source-to-k route takes exactly k chain steps, giving distance -k*1000000000; duplicate edge IDs provide valid alternative parents.

name: dag_full_unreachable_cycle
justification: Vertices 99998 and 99999 form a cycle disconnected from source 0; whole-graph cycle checking must reject it.
